world_preview.settings.general.title: General
world_preview.settings.general.head: General World Preview settings
world_preview.settings.general.threads.t:
Higher numbers speed up the preview.

However, using §lALL§r available threads may cause freezing.
world_preview.settings.general.full.chun: Sample all y-layers all at once

When disabled, only the currently visible y-layer is sampled, instead of fully sampling all y-layers.

Sampling only a single layer is initially faster, but will make scrolling through the y-layers less seamless.
world_preview.settings.general.backgroun: Sample adjacent y-layers in the background

When enabled, neighboring y-layers are sampled in the background once the currently active layer is fully sampled.

Background sampling stops when §lALL§r layers have been sampled.

This option has no effect when all y-layers are sampled all at once.
world_preview.settings.general.struct.to:
Whether to check if a structure is §lLIKELY§r to start in a chunk.

Please note that these results may not be 100% accurate due to the complex nature of structure placement.

§6MODERATE performance impact§r
world_preview.settings.general.heightmap:
Whether to generate a heightmap for the dimension

§cHIGH performance impact§r
world_preview.settings.general.intersect:
Whether to sample the locations of opaque and air blocks, to highlight caves and mountains.

This is done §lBEFORE§r the world is carved, so this will be inaccurate!

§cHIGH performance impact§r
world_preview.settings.general.noise.too:
Whether to store the raw noise values used to determine the biome.

Enabling this option should not reduce performance, however, it will increase the RAM usage and size on disk when caching is enabled.

§cHIGH RAM / Disk impact§r
Show the controls in the preview tooltip
world_preview.settings.general.frametime: Show the frame time of the preview render
world_preview.settings.general.minimap.t: Show a small overview map in the corner of the preview, indicating the current viewport position within the entire sampled area
world_preview.settings.general.statistic: Show real-time sampling progress, biome/structure counts, thread count, and elapsed time
world_preview.settings.general.coordinat: Show the current center coordinates at the bottom-left of the preview
world_preview.settings.general.zoom.tool:
When enabled, the scroll wheel adjusts the map zoom level (default).

When disabled, the scroll wheel adjusts Y height.

Ctrl+scroll always zooms; Alt+scroll always adjusts Y.
world_preview.settings.general.preload.t:
When enabled, areas beyond the visible range are preloaded to reduce stuttering when dragging

§6Minor performance impact§r
world_preview.settings.general.preload_i: When enabled, preloading only occurs when worker threads are idle to avoid impacting sampling performance
world_preview.settings.general.preload_r:
How many blocks beyond the visible range to preload

§cHigher values preload more but consume more resources§r

world_preview.settings.cache.clear.toolt:
Clicking this button will clear the §6§lcurrent§r cache.

If the preview was opened from a running world, only the preview cache for §lthis§r world will be cleared. If the preview was opened during world creation, §oall§r previews for §oall§r seeds for the world creation will be cleared.
